title: Catriona Gray successfully does 'fairy walk' in Siquijor
desc:
Beauty queen Catriona Gray is enjoying her trip to Siquijor.
Catriona did not miss the chance to visit Cambugahay Falls where one can try the "fairy walk."
The fairy walk is a popular tourist activity at the falls where participants hang from a rope swing and glide over water, creating the illusion of walking on its surface.
Catriona successfully completed her fairy walk and shared the video on Instagram
"She was a fairy ," she wrote on the caption of her post.
